protocol.name: neferwl_image_capture_v1
protocol.copyright: neferwl private protocol. No stability promise beyond the version of the interface.
protocol.description:
Optional additions to ext-image-capture-source-v1, ext-workspace-v1 and ext-image-copy-capture-v1 for what those protocols do not cover: workspace and output-region capture sources, the frame of a workspace, and leaving a client's own surfaces (a recording HUD) out of its captures.
Capture always goes through ext-image-copy-capture. The compositor applies the same rules to every capture, whatever its source: it may refuse a client (ext_image_copy_capture_session_v1.stopped), and it draws its own capture indicator on screen, never in a captured image, which no client can turn off.

interface.name: neferwl_image_capture_source_manager_v1
interface.description: Global. Sources created here are ext_image_capture_source_v1 objects, used with ext_image_copy_capture_manager_v1.create_session like any other source.

entry.name: invalid_region
entry.summary: width or height is not positive

request.name: destroy
request.description: Sources created through it stay valid.

request.name: create_workspace_source
request.description: The source is the workspace frame, without bars, whether or not the workspace is on screen: a workspace that is not on screen is rendered for capture only. Its buffer size follows the workspace frame. A session on it is stopped when the workspace is removed. A handle already removed gives a source whose sessions stop at once.

request.name: create_output_region_source

description.summary: capture a rectangle of an output

request.description: The rectangle is in output-local logical pixels and is clipped to the output. The buffer covers only that rectangle, in physical pixels. A session on it is stopped when the output goes away or when nothing of the rectangle is left on the output.

request.name: get_workspace_frame

description.summary: learn the frame of a workspace

request.description: ext-workspace-v1 carries no geometry. The frame object reports the rectangle that a workspace source of the same handle captures. For a handle already removed, the object never sends frame.

interface.name: neferwl_workspace_frame_v1
interface.description: The frame is the area of its output that the workspace draws in, without bars: the whole output, or the smaller size set for the workspace.

event.name: frame
event.description: The frame in output-local logical pixels. Sent when the object is created and again whenever the frame changes. Not sent once the workspace is removed.

interface.name: neferwl_capture_exclusion_manager_v1

description.summary: leave a client's own surfaces out of its captures

interface.description: Global. A recorder asks for an exclusion on its capture session and gets a token; its HUD, usually on another connection of the same user, attaches layer surfaces with that token. Frames of that session leave the attached surfaces out. Every other capture shows them.

entry.name: surface_role
entry.summary: the surface is not a wlr-layer-shell surface

entry.name: invalid_layer
entry.summary: the layer is neither top nor overlay

entry.name: exclusive_keyboard
entry.summary: the layer takes the keyboard exclusively

entry.name: already_excluded
entry.summary: the capture session already has an exclusion

request.name: destroy
request.description: Exclusions and attachments created through it stay alive.

request.name: get_exclusion

description.summary: create the exclusion of a capture session

request.description: The exclusion answers with exactly one of token or failed. It ends with the capture session.

request.name: attach_surface

description.summary: attach a layer surface to an exclusion by token

request.description:
Marks a layer surface of this client as excluded from the frames of the session that owns the token. The client must have the same user ID as the compositor and must also be allowed to capture: its executable is on the capture allowlist (or the allowlist is off), it is not sandboxed, and the session is not locked. The surface must already have the wlr-layer-shell role, on the top or overlay layer, must not have mapped yet and must not ask for exclusive keyboard interactivity. At most 4 layers per exclusion. An attached layer never gets keyboard interactivity; if it moves to another layer the compositor closes it and sends detached.
The attachment answers with exactly one of attached or failed. The surface is excluded from this request on, before it can map; the client must not show it before attached.

interface.name: neferwl_capture_exclusion_v1

description.summary: the exclusion of one capture session

interface.description: Destroying it detaches every attached layer.

entry.name: busy
entry.summary: another exclusion is live in the compositor

event.name: token
event.description: 64 lowercase hexadecimal characters (32 random bytes). A secret for the owner and its HUD, never logged, valid until the exclusion ends.

interface.name: neferwl_capture_layer_v1

description.summary: a layer surface attached to an exclusion

interface.description: Created by attach_surface. Exactly one of attached or failed comes first; detached comes at most once, after attached.

entry.name: unknown_token
entry.summary: no live exclusion has this token

entry.name: unauthorized
entry.summary: peer credentials differ from the compositor user's or are unreadable, or the client may not capture (not on the allowlist, sandboxed, or session locked)

entry.name: too_many_layers
entry.summary: the exclusion already has 4 attached layers

entry.name: exclusion_ended
entry.summary: the exclusion ended before the compositor confirmed the layer

entry.name: layer_destroyed
entry.summary: the layer role was destroyed before the compositor confirmed it

entry.name: exclusion_ended
entry.summary: the exclusion ended; the compositor closed the layer surface

request.name: destroy
request.description: The surface stays excluded until its layer role is destroyed or the exclusion ends.

event.name: attached
event.description: The compositor confirmed the attachment. Safe to show.

event.name: detached
event.description: Sent once after attached. When the exclusion ended, the compositor also closed the layer surface (zwlr_layer_surface_v1.closed).
